player_prompt.intro:
UnguMdlali {player_id} kwi-Nim.
Injongo yakho kukuthatha into yokugqibela esele.
Ngokunye ujikelezo, khetha ipuli elinye kuphela uze uyonde into enye noma zinini kuyo.
Sebenzisa ifomethi '[pile quantity]', apho ipuli li-index ye-puli kunye ne-quantity ibe inani leento onokuziyo ndayo.
Njengokomzekelo, '[0 3]' iyonde into ezintathu kwi-puli 0.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Akukho fomathi yokutshintsha ifumanekileyo. Sebenzisa '[pile quantity]'.

observation.removed_from_piles: Mdlali {player_id} udalile [{pile_index} {quantity}], ukhupha {quantity} into (okanye iinto) kwi-pile {pile_index}.
